history.body: Hi, saw your Pearl Residences ad. We’re renting nearby and starting to look for our first place. Can share a bit more?

Sure 🙂 Phase 1 homes are Type A: 900 sq ft, with 3 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms and a balcony. For a first home, that gives you flexibility in how you use the bedrooms. The established Seberang Jaya location also connects toward Sunway Carnival Mall, Chai Leng Park and Butterworth. Are you looking for a place to live in yourselves?
Yes, for ourselves. We’re still comparing a couple of places, but having an extra room sounds useful. Do you have a general starting price?

The lowest listed reference I can share is an indicative RM301,760, calculated from a RM328,000 base with the 8% package in the 14 Aug 2026 snapshot. That isn’t a confirmed current offer or all-in price; current package eligibility and any applicable parking or accessory components need checking for a specific unit. With 3 bedrooms in 900 sq ft, the extra room could give you useful flexibility as a work or guest room. Since you’re comparing, a viewing could help you judge how the layout feels in person.
The price is around what we had in mind, though we’d still need to check the total costs. My partner sometimes works from home, so an extra room could be useful. Do you have a layout we can look at?

Yes—the Type A is 900 sq ft, with 3 bedrooms and 2 bathrooms. Its layout concept shows an open living/dining/kitchen area and separate bedrooms, so one could potentially work as your partner’s home office while the shared area stays for both of you. I’ll check for the approved floor-plan image to share; exact furniture fit is best judged from that. The price mentioned is only a starting reference, so we can check a full total once you’ve narrowed down a unit.
Okay, please send it when you find it. The office setup is something we’d want to check, and we still need to understand the full monthly cost before deciding.

Yes—I’m still checking for the approved Type A plan and will share it when I have it. For a recurring cost, the stated maintenance fee is RM0.18 per sq ft, inclusive of the sinking fund—about RM162/month for 900 sq ft. That isn’t the full monthly cost: financing payments and any applicable charges depend on the unit and loan terms, so I won’t guess. I’ll check what we can confirm so you can assess both the office layout and the monthly commitment.
Thanks, the RM162 is useful as one part of the cost. We’ll still need to understand the loan payment too, but I know that depends on the unit and terms. Please share the layout once you find it.

Of course—I’ll share the approved Type A plan once I have it; I don’t have the diagram to send yet. The layout concept shows the bedrooms separate from the open living, dining and kitchen area, with two windows shown in each secondary bedroom. The approved plan will let you check the room dimensions and whether a desk setup fits alongside any other furniture. I’ll also share the monthly-cost details once they’re confirmed; for now, RM162 is the maintenance fee including sinking fund, not the full monthly cost.
